notes.title: Update 1.1.07030
notes.content: This update fixes an issue with certain tiles getting stuck after using the clear errors button

notes.title: Update 1.1.02080
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which double-clicking on a tile could cause a mismatch between a tile’s visual state and its "true" state.
[*] Added Ctrl+Z as a keyboard shortcut to undo a move (you can also use the backspace or U keys).
[*] Fixed the undo feature panning the camera to random locations instead of undoing your moves.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.12182 + Discord, Newsletter and a free sequel!
notes.content:
This update introduces a few QoL improvements from Proverbs:

[list]
[*] Added edge scrolling as an optional setting in the menu
[*] Added the option to invert left and right click 
[*] Added mailing list and discord links to the settings menu
[/list]

[h2]New Game Announcement![/h2]

[previewyoutube=vGXn43o0IdM;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate the end of the year, I’m thrilled to announce 2024: Mosaic Retrospective, the third entry in the Mega Mosaic series!

[b]This is a full 60,000 tile Mega Mosaic game and will be [u]completely free[/u] for anyone to download and play![/b]

As you solve the puzzle you'll reveal a stunning pixel art collage crammed with over 90 news stories from 2024, ranging from politics, war, science, pop culture, music and memes... just about anything and everything that made the headlines!

[b]While the game is free, I have created an accompanying fundraiser for UNICEF. If you enjoy the experience, please consider donating to it and help me reach my £2,000 goal to support children worldwide. Every contribution counts![/b]

[url=https://www.justgiving.com/page/2024-mosaic-retrospective][b]Donate[/b][/url] | [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380760/2024_Mosaic_Retrospective/][b]Wishlist[/b][/url] the game to get notified of its release on 26th Dec!

[h2]Newsletter registration open![/h2]
Recent changes to the Steam News feed mean that it might be harder for me to notify you that a game that you enjoyed has a sequel. To make sure you get all the latest news, you can [url=https://dividetheplunder.com/sendy/subscription?f=19uoLkFrtwjFX2hXnkFALMnNTkahOv1A3JeTJG6m4LnbSDjKwONC6qgGEmg92AAl]sign up for the email newsletter[/url].

[h2]Discord launched![/h2]
Want to discuss your mosaic-solving techniques with other players? Want to ping me a quick question directly? There is now an official Divide the Plunder Discord available! [url=https://discord.gg/Ge7K2Bng]Join the conversation[/url].

Thank you for your support, and I hope you love solving the new Mega Mosaic!

Cheers,
Mark

notes.title: Update 1.0.15110
notes.content: This update fixes an issue that could prevent "Reset puzzle" from working.

notes.title: Update 1.0.11030
notes.content:
This update addresses a couple of pieces of player feedback:

[list]
[*] The clear errors button will now appear after 3 errors have been made anywhere on the board, and will no longer require a filled region.
[*] Added more checks to ensure SFX and Music volume settings are saved correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.10120
notes.content:
This update aims to make the save system more robust:

[list]
[*] The game now rotates a series of save files, and will roll back to an older one in the event of a player's save getting corrupted.
[*] There is a new "Recovery Mode" option in the settings menu in case all of a players saves are lost. This will fill in any regions that you've already unlocked achievements for.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Now Available for Proverbs! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey Zen Puzzlers!

I’m thrilled to announce that the demo for Proverbs is now live, just in time for Steam Next Fest (October 14th-21st)! If you enjoyed Mega Mosaic, you won’t want to miss out on this sequel.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3219020/Proverbs_Demo/]Download Demo
[/url]
🧩 Proverbs takes the mosaic puzzle formula you know and love to the next level. This time, you’ll be piecing together over 100 Dutch proverbs and idioms hidden within Pieter Bruegel the Elder’s 1559 painting Netherlandish Proverbs. You’ll reveal intricate illustrations while uncovering the meaning behind many age-old sayings that still have equivalents today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981493/e3e802697d31fd84370a275e6bad190a4d3f2e03.jpg[/img]

⏳ The demo offers  hours of calming, addictive puzzle-solving. Can’t wait to see what you think!

💡 New features and gameplay changes include:

[list]
[*] A new border system where clues can describe areas smaller than 9 tiles, adding an extra layer of challenge.
[*] A more balanced puzzle structure, with more evenly sized regions compared to Mega Mosaic's huge areas.
[*] Since clues don't bleed into neighbouring regions, each region is a self-enclosed puzzle in it's own right!
[*] Play through a huge 10%+ of the full puzzle in the demo, progress will carry forward into the full release!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981493/046972d2800e8bef0d9bb4f6f685cbb19c046e20.jpg[/img]

Whether you like playing with your favorite podcast in the background or using the game’s soothing built-in renaissance soundtrack, Proverbs is designed to fit perfectly into your relaxation time.

Head over to the Proverbs store page, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3219020/Proverbs_Demo/]download the demo[/url], and don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game for all the latest updates!

Enjoy and happy puzzling!

— Mark @ Divide The Plunder

P.S. With the advent of Valve changing how demos work on Steam, it's now possible to review the Proverbs demo independently of the main game. All reviews help push visibility of the demo, so any feedback added in this way, positive or negative, is very welcome!

notes.title: Update 1.0.07141
notes.content:
This update adds a couple of additional options to the settings menu:

[list]
[*] Added a brightness slider
[*] Added a toggle for the glow effect
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.06040
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with border tiles displaying incorrectly when using the inverted colours setting.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.05171
notes.content:
This hotfix addresses a couple of urgent issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed an error on boot that would stop the game loading correctly and would prevent clues from appearing on the board.
[*] Fixed an issue with the boundaries between regions having the wrong colour.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.05150
notes.content:
This minor update fixes a few gameplay issues:

[list]
[*] Clearing errors no longer removes tiles from solved regions.
[*] Clearing errors now correctly reduces the total completion stat.
[*] The game should now be better at detecting if the edge of a solved region needs to remain visible.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.05100
notes.content:
This minor update introduces some new helpful functionality:

[list]
[*] Added a "Clear Errors" button. This will only appear once you have completely filled a region, but you don't have the correct solution. The button removes all incorrect tiles on the board, plus all their neighbouring tiles.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.05090
notes.content:
This minor update fixes several gameplay issues that have been raised by the community:

[list]
[*] By default, clicking again on a filled tile will now clear it, rather than cycling to the next colour. This can be changed back in the general settings tab if required.
[*] Clues will no longer disappear in solved regions if they are next to a region boundary (this is to fix hints highlighting a square with no clues).
[*] Border achievements will now only be granted if you have the correct solution for the edge squares.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.05061
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone that provided feedback in the forums! This update aims to address most of the issues raised.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] The middle mouse (scrollwheel) button now drags the camera
[*] You can now press [b]U[/b] or [b]Backspace [/b] to undo
[*] Added a button to the settings menu to reset the entire puzzle
[*] Added a settings toggle to invert the light/dark colour scheme
[*] Added a settings toggle to disable error warnings
[*] Clues now fade out when they are surrounded by filled tiles
[*] Hints now give a better indication of which squares should be filled
[*] The default music volume has been reduced to 60%
[*] The game now zooms in on a hint at the start of your first session, rather than focusing on the bottom left of the board.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed a confusing blue tile that could appear at the corner of the board at the start of a game.
[/list]
